data.body: Final CI-latency stocktake after Gerrit 1817 merged. Closed puppylike-emo-rasbora after completing the all-tests-over-1s audit: all 501 normalized phases at or above 1s are recorded on that ticket, and no sampled CI pytest phase exceeded 30s. Closed parent inedible-subsimious-brahmancow after a signed completion-verifier PASS; all accepted consensus-backed remediations are merged. The three newest qualifying full Gerrit Verify runs were 22m47s, 26m14s, and 25m53s (mean 24m58s, median 25m53s), meeting the 20-30 minute average goal. The 57m29s failed outlier was 25m13s of superseded-run admission plus a 30m23s macOS job, not an individual long-running test; Gerrit 1792 addressed that admission failure mode. Mutation testing consumed 53m42s aggregate runner time when selected but completed before macOS, so it added zero sampled critical-path wall. Gerrit 1817 moved only proven platform-invariant tests from macOS and is estimated to save about 8s macOS wall and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds. Residuals panpsychic-clever-hawk and ravenous-beribboned-walleye are blocked because no consensus-safe fidelity-preserving implementation was found; retain the exact 24-commit import contract and current real-boundary coverage. Open unclaimed research/implementation follow-ups are songful-groovelike-horsemouse, lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, and rival-ammoniacal-crustacean. RAM-disk treatment remains rejected because measured variants were 5.5-20% slower. This finalization made no code edits, pushes, workflow dispatches, or control patchsets; worktree remained at origin/main 95f97cbeb6344aa5641fb07f6f74618a49581425 pending final cleanliness verification.
